attempts.summary: Established an AIDE-based file integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (RHEL 10). Installed aide, added an explicit /etc FIPSR rule to aide.conf, initialized the database (36,014 entries), activated it as /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz, and recorded a sha256 checksum plus creation timestamp for the baseline artifact. Verified detection works end-to-end: aide --check reports clean against the untouched baseline, flags an injected content change to /etc/hosts (exit code 4, size/hash diff shown) and returns clean again after the file was restored. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and a clean aide --check, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed the boot_id changed, and reconfirmed the AIDE database checksum and a clean aide --check post-restart.
